effect_description_eng:
[Hand] [Counter] ＜Blast Digivolve＞ (Your Digimon may digivolve into this card without paying the cost.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] If you have 3 or more security cards, suspend 1 Digimon, and 1 of your Digimon gets +3000 DP until the end of your opponent's turn. If you have 3 or fewer security cards, return 1 of your opponent's suspended Digimon to the bottom of the deck.
[All Turns] While this Digimon is suspended, it isn't affected by the effects of your opponent's Digimon.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Ace Overflow ＜-4＞ (As this card moves from the field or under a card to an area other than those, lose 4 memory.)
